text:
Type: small metal cube cabinet
Use: storing small items, media and office supplies; living room, home office, bedroom, hallway
Style: industrial, minimalist, modern
Materials: powder-coated steel body and door, small metal tab pull
Colors: white, light grey pull
Shape: compact cube with one flat door set inside a thin frame, small side tab pull, crisp edges, low feet, small and light, stackable look
Feel: crisp, tidy, utilitarian, fresh
Goes with: bright colors, light wood, concrete or white walls; industrial, modern or minimalist rooms and small workspaces

product.name: LIXHULT
product.description: Helps you keep track of small items like chargers, keys and wallets, or more bulky items like handbags and toys. It all depends on which of the 3 cabinet sizes you choose.
